Suddenly, messes start appearing in the bathroom and kitchen, but every time Kaden, Andrea, or Auntie checks the room, the doll freezes perfectly still. Between the mystery of the moving toy, a trip to the store for cereal, and some high-energy fun in the ball pit, Maddie has her hands full trying to prove her innocence. This morning routine takes a wild turn as everyone struggles to figure out who is really behind the household clutter.
